sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 34 points from 16 games, travel to New Mills on Saturday 14 November for an Edward Case Cup 2 tie. The leaders arrive in excellent form, having won their most recent league match and winning three of their last five league games, so they will be confident despite facing opponents who sit 10th in the league.
divisionWide: Second-placed Eccleshall host Bilston Town on Saturday as part of a tight title race; Eccleshall are unbeaten in their last four league matches while Bilston are also in strong form with one draw and one loss in their last six. Third-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, who have won four of their last five league games, travel to New Mills on Wednesday evening in a midweek fixture. Allscott Heath face Dawley Town at home on Saturday in a mid-table clash between sides in contrasting form—Allscott Heath have won their last league match while Dawley Town are also recent winners. Brereton Social host Crewe on Saturday; Crewe have lost their last league match while Brereton Social have also struggled recently. Foley Meir entertain Market Drayton Town on Saturday in a bottom-half encounter. Telford Town play host to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday; both sides have endured difficult recent form. Wednesfield Community welcome Widnes Town on Saturday as two of the division's lowest-placed teams meet. On Tuesday, Shawbury United host AFC Bridgnorth, fourth in the table who have won their most recent league match and remain strong contenders. Wednesday sees Bilston Town face Alsager Town at home; Alsager are bottom of the league and struggling badly while Bilston are in good shape.
